entries.description: Notice that an alarm will remind the user when it is time to eat.
Notice that an alarm will ring in %1$d minutes to remind the user to eat.
Nightscout connection state shown when the server accepted the token and granted full API permissions.
Name of the basal value, used inside the out-of-limits message.
Warning that the profile has basal values not starting at full hours, which the pump cannot do. %1$s lists the values or time.

entries.ui_location: Bolus wizard; confirmation lines; quick wizard
entries.description: Label 'Bolus': an amount of insulin given at once, usually for a meal or a correction.

entries.ui_location: Bolus wizard and fill dialog > confirmation
entries.description: Warning that a safety limit lowered the insulin amount. %1$.2f is the original amount, %2$.2f the new amount, both in units.
Progress line during bolus delivery. %1$.2f is the insulin delivered so far, %2$.2f the total requested, both in units (U).
Final line of the bolus progress dialog once the pump has delivered the whole bolus. %1$.2f is the amount in units (U).
Progress line shown while a bolus is being delivered. %1$.2f is the insulin delivered so far, in units (U).

entries.ui_location: Insulin dialog banner; bolus wizard confirmation
entries.description: Warning that the bolus is only logged in the app and the pump does not deliver it (for example insulin already given with a pen).

entries.ui_location: Bolus wizard; Carbs input; Automation elements
entries.description: Label 'Carbs' (carbohydrates in grams) for a field or line.
Label for the wizard's correction that compares carbs on board (COB) to insulin on board (IOB).

entries.ui_location: Confirmation dialogs (Overview, Configuration, Maintenance, Setup wizard)
entries.description: Title of generic OK/Cancel confirmation dialogs, for example before switching pump hardware or resetting the database. A single noun.
Template for one line of a confirmation dialog: %1$s is a label (e.g. Carbs), %2$s the value. Keep the colon style of your language.

entries.ui_location: Overview > pump status line; NSClient status; SMS reply
entries.description: Status word 'Connected', used for the pump link, the Nightscout client websocket (after 'WS: ') and in the SMS answer to a pump connect command.
Pump status while a connection attempt is in progress. %1$d is the number of seconds elapsed. The 's' is the unit seconds.
Unit word 'days' placed after a number, such as in a pump or patch expiry line ('3 days 4 hours'). Not a plural-aware string.
Relative time in days. %1$.1f is days since the event. Used when the value is not rounded.
Relative time in days, rounded to a whole number. %1$.0f is days since the event.

Comment stored in the metadata of the built-in default custom watchface. It tells the user they can press the export button to get a template to edit. The button is named 'EXPORT WATCHFACE' in the app.
Comment of the default watchface variant that includes external views for followers. Mentions the EXPORT WATCHFACE button to get a template.
Pump status while the app is closing the link to the pump.
Hint listing insulin brands that fit the rapid-acting profile. Brand names, comma separated.
Shown instead of a number when a duration is longer than about 1000 days, meaning 'no end'.
Carbs amount in grams. %1$d is grams. Keep it short.

entries.ui_location: Bolus wizard confirmation; insulin amount texts
entries.description: Insulin amount in units (U). %1$.2f is the amount.
Insulin amount with an explicit sign (+ or -), in units. %1$+.2f is the amount.
Name of the insulin profile in which the user sets the peak time freely (oref model). 'Oref' is the name of the algorithm family.
Pump status while the app and pump exchange the first messages after a link is made (the connection is not usable yet).
Unit word 'hours' placed after a number in an expiry line ('3 days 4 hours').
Relative time in hours with a short unit. %1$.1f is hours since the event.

entries.ui_location: Date and time texts; Statistics > activity
entries.description: Future time in days. %1$.0f is the number of days from now. Also used as a label in the activity statistics.
Future time in whole days (rounded down). %1$.0f is days from now.
Short description of the field where the user enters the time of peak insulin action. [min] means minutes.
Relative day label for a time that is still ahead today.

entries.ui_location: Running mode texts; command rejection messages
entries.description: Running mode 'Loop suspended' (the user paused the loop). Also used as the reason text when a bolus is blocked.
Insulin brand name (Lyumjev). Do not translate.
The basal value in the profile was above the pump's maximum and was lowered to it. %1$s is the original value.
Metadata line: %1$s is the version of the custom watchface format (CWF) the file was made for.
Metadata line: %1$s is the author of the watchface.
Metadata line about a custom watchface file. %1$s is the creation date. Keep the colon and placeholder.
Metadata line: %1$s is the free-text comment written by the watchface author.
Metadata line: %1$s is the watchface name.
Metadata line for author with their file version. %1$s is the author name, %2$s the version.
Metadata line: %1$s is the file name of the watchface zip.
Short suffix with the extra duration in whole minutes, shown in brackets, e.g. '(+5m)'. %1$d is minutes. Not a sentence.

entries.ui_location: Pump overview > last connection; watch and status lines
entries.description: Short relative time, %1$d is whole minutes since the event. Sits in tight spaces such as a status row or in brackets after a clock time, so keep it short (like '5m ago').
Relative time written out in full. %1$d is the number of minutes since the event.
The basal value in the profile was below the pump's minimum and was raised to it. %1$s is the original value.
Number of minutes with short unit. %1$d is minutes, may be negative (shown as an offset).
Explanation why the app needs Bluetooth: to talk to the insulin pump.
Title of the explanation shown before the system asks for Bluetooth permission. One word.
Error shown if a plugin crashed while starting. %1$s is the plugin name. Asks to restart the app (AAPS).
Error shown if a plugin hit an error during its work. %1$s is the plugin name. Asks to restart the app (AAPS).

entries.ui_location: Time-ago text (e.g. history lists, exported file age)
entries.description: Plural string: days and hours since an event. %1$s is the number of days, %2$s the number of hours. The plural form follows the count of days.
Plural string: hours since an event. %1$s is the number of hours; the plural form follows the same count.
Plural string: minutes since an event. %1$s is the number of minutes; the plural form follows the same count.
Checkbox title: switch for showing how long ago the last glucose reading arrived on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the average glucose change over a longer period (AvgDelta) on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the current basal rate on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'. Also used for the basal line in graph preferences.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the glucose value on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing blood glucose impact (BGI), the expected glucose change from insulin activity on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing carbs on board (COB) on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'. Also used for the carbs line in graph preferences.
Checkbox title: switch for showing watch complication slot 1 on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'. 'Complication' is the Wear OS term for a small data widget on the watch face.
Checkbox title: switch for showing watch complication slot 2 on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'. 'Complication' is the Wear OS term for a small data widget on the watch face.
Checkbox title: switch for showing watch complication slot 3 on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'. 'Complication' is the Wear OS term for a small data widget on the watch face.
Checkbox title: switch for showing watch complication slot 4 on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'. 'Complication' is the Wear OS term for a small data widget on the watch face.
Checkbox title: switch for showing watch complication slot 5 on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'. 'Complication' is the Wear OS term for a small data widget on the watch face.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the date on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the glucose change since the last reading (delta) on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the glucose delta with more decimals on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing IOB split into bolus and basal parts on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the glucose trend arrow on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing insulin on board (IOB) on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the closed loop status on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the battery level of the phone running AAPS on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the insulin reservoir level of the pump on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the battery level of the rig (a separate uploader device) on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing seconds in the clock on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the active temporary target on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Checkbox title: switch for showing the calendar week number on the watch face. Short noun phrase after 'Show'.
Unit for insulin to carb ratio (IC): grams of carbs covered by one unit of insulin.
Name of the insulin to carb ratio (IC) profile value, used in out-of-limits messages.
Name of the duration of insulin action (DIA) profile value, used in out-of-limits messages.
Name of the profile's upper glucose target, used inside out-of-limits messages.
Unit for basal rate: units of insulin per hour.
Unit of insulin sensitivity factor (ISF): glucose drop in mg/dL per one unit of insulin. Short unit string.
Unit of insulin sensitivity factor (ISF): glucose drop in mmol/L per one unit of insulin.
Name of the profile's lower glucose target, used as the name inside out-of-limits messages.
Name of the insulin sensitivity (ISF) profile value, used in out-of-limits messages.

entries.ui_location: Running mode texts; command rejection messages
entries.description: Running mode where the user has disconnected the pump, for example to shower. Also a reason text for rejected commands.
Reason text passed to the command queue when the pump driver is switched and the pump status is read again. Mostly seen in logs and the queue status.
Reason text: the pump reports itself as suspended, so commands cannot be sent. Also a line in the pump status summary.
Name of the rapid-acting insulin profile, named after a brand (Novorapid). Brand names are usually left as they are.
Default note saved with a treatment that is only recorded and not given by the pump. A noun/verb.
Short suffix with the extra duration in seconds, shown in brackets, e.g. '(+30s)'. %1$d is seconds. Not a sentence.

entries.ui_location: Status lines (time since last reading or connection)
entries.description: Short relative time for under a minute, %1$d is seconds. Keep it as short as possible.
Used when an event happened less than a minute ago. There is no number, so it works as a stand-alone phrase.
One-letter abbreviation for days, appended to a number ('2d'). Followed directly by hours, as in '2d3h'.

entries.ui_location: Profile comparison; age and expiry texts; wizard confirmation
entries.description: One-letter or very short unit for hours, appended to a number ('5h'). Used where space is tight.

entries.ui_location: Age texts; user action log CSV header; action values
entries.description: One-letter abbreviation for minutes, appended to a number ('5m'). Also a column unit in the exported user action log.
Warning line about carbs absorbing slowly. %1$d%% is how much of the time absorption was slow. The exclamation marks signal a warning; the text also advises double-checking the calculation.
Description of a temporary basal with an absolute rate. %1$.2f is the rate in U/h, %2$s the start time, %3$d minutes elapsed and %4$d the total duration in minutes. The apostrophe stands for minutes.
Description of an extended bolus, which is delivered over time at a rate. 'E' marks it as extended. %1$.2f is the rate in U/h, %2$s start time, %3$d minutes elapsed, %4$d total minutes.
Description of a temporary basal as a percent of the profile basal. %1$.2f is the percent, %2$s start time, %3$d minutes elapsed, %4$d total minutes. '%%' is a literal percent sign.
Time left until something expires or ends. %1$d is whole hours, %2$d remaining minutes.
Time left when under one hour. %1$d is minutes.

entries.ui_location: Relative date labels; Statistics > TDD; Wear TDD message
entries.description: Relative day label. In date lists it is followed by ' - ' and the date; in the TDD statistics it labels the row for the current day. Keep it short.
Relative day label for dates falling on the next day.
Insulin concentration U10: 10 units of insulin per millilitre. A product code, not translated.
Insulin concentration U100: 100 units of insulin per millilitre. A product code, not translated.
Insulin concentration U200: 200 units of insulin per millilitre. A product code, not translated.
Insulin concentration U300: 300 units of insulin per millilitre. A product code, not translated.
Insulin concentration U40: 40 units of insulin per millilitre. A product code, not translated.
Insulin concentration U50: 50 units of insulin per millilitre. A product code, not translated.
Insulin concentration U500: 500 units of insulin per millilitre. A product code, not translated.

entries.ui_location: Bolus wizard confirmation; user action log
entries.description: Label for extended carbs (eCarbs): carbs entered with a duration and absorbed over time. Upper case in the source because it is a log type.
Hint listing insulin brands that fit the ultra-rapid profile.
Name of the ultra-rapid insulin profile, named after a brand (Fiasp). Brand names are usually left as they are.
Singular unit 'day', used after the number 1. Plural form is the matching unit_days key.
Plural unit 'days', used after a number other than 1 in duration texts.
Singular unit 'hour', used after the number 1. Plural form is the matching unit_hours key.
Plural unit 'hours', used after a number other than 1 in duration texts.
Singular unit 'minute', used after the number 1. Plural form is the matching unit_minutes key.

entries.ui_location: Automation > trigger editor (steps count window); duration texts
entries.description: Plural unit 'minutes', used after a number other than 1 in duration texts. Also the unit label next to the time window in the steps count trigger.
Singular unit 'second', used after the number 1. Plural form is the matching unit_seconds key.
Plural unit 'seconds', used after a number other than 1 in duration texts.
Singular unit 'week', used after the number 1. Plural form is the matching unit_weeks key.
Plural unit 'weeks', used after a number other than 1 in duration texts.

entries.ui_location: Insulin and concentration pickers; trend arrow list
entries.description: Generic option 'Unknown' for an insulin type, insulin concentration, or a trend arrow that is not set.
Error: a setting is outside the safety limits. %1$s is the setting name (another string, such as Profile DIA value), %2$.2f the value. The » « quotes are part of the text.
Pump status shown while the app waits for the pump link to close after a command has finished.
Name (and file name) shown for the built-in default custom watchface.
Button that opens the watch's store page to find more watch faces. Short.
Extended carbs summary. %1$d is grams, %2$d duration in hours, %3$d delay in minutes. The g, h and min are unit abbreviations.
Relative day label, shown followed by ' - ' and the date.
